title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - FinalWaste
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/FinalWaste. State of waste that has been processed by a waste disposal device. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest directly (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.3.3.2.2) -- note it does NOT subclass s4envi:Resource or geo:Feature in the ontology, unlike Waste/PrimaryRawResource/SecondaryRawResource, so it has no location attribute. Target of s4envi:Waste.becomes and s4envi:WasteProcessingDevice.produces.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FinalWaste'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasCreationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasCreationDate'. Final waste and secondary raw resources have a creation date that corresponds to the date on which their creation was completed.
